scope: Static baseline of routed handlers, categories and runtime overlays; not proof of redesign implementation or runtime behavior.
limitations: Form candidates include action fields as well as filters. Query keys include selectors and compatibility aliases. Helper-generated columns/actions require the accompanying manual review.

hosts: Hosts, subdomains and discovered network names
apis: REST, GraphQL, WebSocket and API-like routes
authentication: Login, session, token, recovery, OAuth and identity surfaces
admin_internal: Administrative, internal, debug and management surfaces
file_upload: Upload, download, import, export and file-handling surfaces
data_object: Object identifiers and business-data access surfaces
client_side: JavaScript, source maps and client-discovered routes
infrastructure: Ports, services, HTTP/TLS fingerprints and technologies
other: Observed surface not yet classified into a stronger security context
